ruleset.name: vb-srp-crosscheck
ruleset.description:
VibeBench convergent-validity cross-check: the PMD design rules that map onto our SRP god-class rubric. Rule DEFAULTS are kept deliberately -- the point is an INDEPENDENT opinion, so re-tuning PMD to agree with us would destroy the only thing it is being asked for.
NOTE: `ExcessiveClassLength` was REMOVED in PMD 7; `NcssCount` (class-level non-commenting source statements) is its documented successor and is used in its place.
